verificationRules: Discovery feeds are never sufficient on their own.
A factual external story requires either one authoritative primary source or at least two credible independent sources.
Rumor, anonymous-source speculation, social reposts without an original source, and unverified screenshots are not publishable.
If material facts conflict across sources, mark the story not publishable and explain the conflict.
Do not manufacture quotes, metrics, valuations, contract values, dates, executive titles, creator audience figures, or deal terms.
Clearly distinguish announced facts from GCT analysis.
Pure tournament scoring/results are normally out of scope unless there is a meaningful creator, media, sponsorship, technology, event-business, or commercial angle.
Political stories are out of scope unless they materially affect golf business; any such coverage must remain factual and neutral.
The GCT Take may interpret business implications but must not invent private motives or undisclosed commercial facts.

commercialIntelligence.rule: Editorial coverage and commercial outreach are separate decisions. A company may be newsworthy without being an appropriate sales target.
